summary: Implementation plan for the interactive "comment thread" FAQ page (/id/faq and /en/faq) on chestaa.com (CHESTAADOTCOM). Features 21 bilingual threads grouped across 6 categories, client-side search & expand-all controls, native details/summary semantic HTML for zero-JS SEO and screen reader accessibility, CSS-only typing animation indicators, WhatsApp question composer, and JSON-LD FAQPage schema.
